Invisalign Case Study

Smile Alignment

Patient Profile

Age24
OccupationMarketing Professional
Chief Concern

"Crowded lower teeth and an uncomfortable bite."

Duration

8 Months

1

The Challenge

Mild crowding in the lower jaw made flossing difficult and affected the aesthetics of his smile. He wanted a solution without metal braces.

2

Our Solution

Invisalign® Clear Aligners were prescribed. We used 3D scanning to create a precise treatment plan.

The Outcome

Perfectly aligned teeth and a corrected bite. The patient maintained his professional appearance throughout the treatment.

"No one even noticed I was wearing them. Best investment for my career and confidence."
